comment: Sentences of a cover letter labeled against fixed CV evidence. Supported claims are backed by their cited evidence; connective sentences are supported only if they state no facts about the candidate.
evidence: Designed and built payment REST APIs in C# with ASP.NET Core on .NET 8. Tuned PostgreSQL queries and indexes, cutting p95 latency from 800 ms to 120 ms.
Led a team of four engineers and mentored two juniors through code reviews and pairing.
Containerized legacy services with Docker and moved them to Kubernetes on AWS.

sentences.text: I am excited to apply for the Senior Backend Engineer role.
At Acme I built payment REST APIs in C# on .NET 8.
I cut p95 latency from 800 ms to 120 ms by tuning PostgreSQL queries and indexes.
I led a team of four engineers and mentored two juniors.
I moved legacy services to Kubernetes on AWS after containerizing them with Docker.
I rewrote the payment APIs in Rust to double their throughput.
I led a team of fifteen engineers across three countries.
I hold the Certified Kubernetes Administrator certification.
I also have ten years of experience with Salesforce.
Thank you for considering my application.
